body:
<!-- plain-summary -->
Once the gateway stores through the cluster's real backends (#454), we need to prove the whole loop actually closes: a file uploaded through the S3 endpoint should land its bookkeeping in the shared metadata store and its data spread across the storage servers, and then the background repair service should be able to see that data and heal it when a server is lost. This is the day-one durability demonstration end to end.

**Summary.** Today the pieces don't form a loop: the gateway writes object metadata to its own local redb and chunks to local disk; the custodian reads metadata from TiKV; the D-servers hold chunks. Nothing writes cluster metadata into TiKV or fans chunks to the D-servers through the gateway, so a `--metadata-backend tikv` custodian opens an (initially empty) store and sees zero repair obligations — the consolidated `deploy/small-multi-node/` stack (#256) stands the topology up but cannot yet demonstrate an end-to-end object pipeline. Once #454 wires the gateway to the cluster backends, this issue proves the loop closes.

**Depends on:** #454 (gateway composes over cluster backends).

**Scope / acceptance.**
- An S3 PUT through a gateway lands object metadata in TiKV and fans chunks across the 9 D-servers of `deploy/small-multi-node/`.
- A `--metadata-backend tikv` custodian pointed at the same store then observes real repair obligations (non-zero work over a populated store).
- The #367 day-one durability check runs on the live stack: killing a D-server makes the under-replicated gauge rise and return to zero on the custodian's live exporter (#366).
- A gateway PUT → GET round-trip reads the object back, reconstructed from D-server fragments.

**Refs:** #454 (depends on), #367 (first-deployment gate / day-one durability loop), #366 (observability floor / live exporter), #257 (Tier-1/2 campaign), #256 (consolidated single-zone deploy).

milestone.title: M4 — Production metadata backend
milestone.description: Step 2. Swap embedded redb for distributed TiKV behind the unchanged MetadataStore trait; multi-key atomic directory ops hold under the distributed store. Completes the single-zone data plane — a soft stopping point, not the release: the ★ Step-2 release point is M8 (proposal 0013 implementation arc, supersedes 0002). Plan: proposal 0015 (supersedes 0007; acceptance PR #417); tracker #201; first-deployment gate #367.

title: End-to-end closed write path: S3 PUT -> TiKV metadata + D-server chunks -> custodian-visible repair
